verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair axis for a developer tool like Bun, but the evidence only shows static CLI docs, llms.txt and markdown docs. Nothing shows an interactive reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. The machine-readable docs are an adjacent capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
